usage.reason: The Teammates API returns no last-login or last-active field and offers no audit log or per-user usage report.

evidence.quote: The API key must be sent as a bearer token in the Authorization header.
This endpoint allows you to retrieve a paginated list of all current Teammates.
Use the `offset` query parameter to control the position in the list from which to start retrieving additional items.

assumptions: Page size of 100 is a guess; the source does not state a maximum for limit.
The default US host is used. EU accounts would need https://api.eu.sendgrid.com instead.
Pending invitations (GET /v3/teammates/pending) are not included, since the runtime handles one user list. They hold no active licence yet.
The user list has no status field, so status is left unmapped. Teammates are treated as existing accounts.
Only first_name is used as the display name; last_name cannot be combined.
No rate limit information was given in the source.
No last-active, audit log or usage report was found in the source, so usage is unavailable.
